findings.problem: The two nonlinear arithmetic arguments reconstruct standard bounds for a convex combination, obscuring the simple reason the path stays between its endpoints.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the proof with:
by
  rw [loadingPath_eq]
  have h₀ := loadingSwitch_nonneg t
  have h₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr (loadingSwitch_le_one t)
  have hsum : 1 - loadingSwitch t + loadingSwitch t = 1 := by ring
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
    And.intro
      (Convex.min_le_combo (fixedLabel i) (z i) h₁ h₀ hsum)
      (Convex.combo_le_max (fixedLabel i) (z i) h₁ h₀ hsum)
findings.benefit: The named lemmas expose the convex-combination argument directly and eliminate four auxiliary product inequalities. They include zero weights and coincident endpoints, so no additional restrictions or cases are needed.
